messages:
ashley.p: quick sync — finalizing vector API launch scope. want to lock batching & dim policy today so eng-platform can finish the impl.

kyle.m: ok. main open items i heard: 1) supported dims (fixed vs arbitrary) 2) response format (floats vs compressed) 3) batching limits & backpressure 4) model selection and default. anything else? :eyes:

maria.g: add: migration path for customers already using 1536. some will expect exact same shape output.

ryan.t: +1. also need to decide server-side up/down-conversion behavior for tenant-specified dims. implementation cost matters.

olivia: from PM/customer side — two pilot customers asked for 1536 and 1024; one asked for 768 in a pinch. we should prioritize native support for the two first, and offer a compatibility mode for others.

ashley.p: proposal: ship with native models that output 1536 (large) and 1024 (small). allow a "requested_dim" query param that, if different, triggers a deterministic fallback: 1) if requested_dim matches one of the native dims, return as-is. 2) if requested_dim < native_dim, support server-side PCA downprojection as an opt-in per-tenant feature (costly, approx 10-20% extra latency). 3) if requested_dim > native_dim, reject with 400 plus guidance.

kyle.m: i like opt-in PCA for compatibility. details: we should only enable for low qps tenants (e.g., < 100 r/s) and rate-limit it. otherwise teams should either host conversion or pick correct model.

maria.g: if we do PCA, we must snapshot the PCA basis per-model and persist it for deterministic outputs. add eval acceptance tests so we detect regressions.

ryan.t: ops note: PCA basis will increase storage per-model (small), and adds compute. we need to update batching logic to mix conversion CPU work into worker threads and avoid blocking GPU loops.

olivia: launch criteria suggestion: 1) correctness: per-dim unit tests + 3 customer datasets passing A/B similarity thresholds, 2) performance: p50 p99 latency targets for 1/10/100 item batches, 3) cost: estimated unit cost within 15% of baseline, 4) SDK + docs updated with examples.

ashley.p: specific batching limits proposed: - single request max items = 2048 - recommended items per batch = 1..512 for production workloads - we will support a streaming chunk mode for very large jobs (background job API), not the realtime endpoint. note: we need to cap total tokens/characters per item to avoid OOM (proposal: 20000 chars).

kyle.m: 2048 max might be fine but we should throttle by a combined metric: items * avg_input_len. otherwise a tenant can send many tiny items or a few massive ones and we blow up memory.

maria.g: format negotiation: default response is JSON with float32 arrays, schema: {"model":"text-embed-3-large","dim":1536,"data":[{"id":"...","embedding":[...]}]}. optional query param `encoding=fp16-base64` to return packed fp16 base64 blobs for bandwidth savings. we should avoid returning hex blobs.

ryan.t: agree on fp16-base64. server will decode into float16 internally. we must document numeric precision tradeoffs and include a reproducible test harness that compares distances against float32 baseline.

olivia: customers asked about streaming embeddings (partial returns). we should clarify: realtime endpoint will return single response per request; long-running large imports get the background job API with incremental results.

ashley.p: here's a sample request/response we can land in docs:

Request (POST /v1/vectors):
```
{
  "model": "text-embed-3-large",
  "inputs": ["doc1 text...","doc2 text..."],
  "encoding": "fp16-base64",
  "requested_dim": 1024
}
```

Response (200):
```
{
  "model": "text-embed-3-large",
  "dim": "1024",
  "data": [
    {"id":"0","embedding":"<base64-fp16-bytes>"},
    {"id":"1","embedding":"<base64-fp16-bytes>"}
  ]
}
```

maria.g: minor nit: keep `dim` as number in docs not string. also include `original_model_dim` when conversion occurred, e.g., `original_model_dim:1536`.

kyle.m: rollout plan: canary 5% of production traffic for 48h, validate p50/p99 and sample similarity scores vs baseline, then 25% for 24h, then 100% if green. include automatic fallback to smaller model if p99 latency crosses threshold.

ryan.t: also add feature flagging per-tenant so we can disable PCA fallback per customer.

olivia: acceptance criteria for product sign-off: docs + SDK examples live, two pilot customers onboarded with SLA checks passing, SLO dashboard showing latency and cost by model/dim, migration guide and a deprecation policy for legacy shapes.

ashley.p: outstanding engineering asks: - eng-platform to add per-tenant rate-limiter based on items*avg_len - eng-runtime to implement optional fp16 encoding path + PCA conversion pipeline - eng-ml to produce PCA bases & evaluation scripts - devex to add SDK helpers and sample scripts

maria.g: i'm going to open the PR for the docs tonight with sample payloads. will tag eng teams.

kyle.m: i'll schedule a 30m follow-up tomorrow to finalize thresholds (batch sizes, qps gates, allowed tenants for PCA).

qa-bot: regression test checklist created: vector-shape-compat, fp16-encoding-roundtrip, pca-determinism, batch-mem-stress. assigned to @ryan.t & @maria.g.

ashley.p: thanks everyone — want to freeze scope after tomorrows follow-up and then we can ship the API gate for eng work. :rocket:
